device: the owner's MiSTer (DE10-Nano), Main_MiSTer binary of 2026-10-19
loaded_with: MGL via /dev/MiSTer_cmd load_core (_Console/Gameboy, setname CORPUSGBC, file type f index 1)
timing: real time: script frames played as wall-clock 1/59.7275 s (the Game Boy frame rate) by the MiSTer rig

options.config/CORPUSGBC.CFG: Autosave On (status bit 13), every other option at its default; written for the run and removed after

save_trigger: OSD opened (F12 from a uinput keyboard) with Autosave on: the core writes its backup RAM to the SD card
note: The MiSTer variant of the corpus script: the same inputs, with the analog stick held for tilt (the core's MBC7 reads accelerometer = 0x81D0 - left stick), and each text stretch tapped until the screen shows the box it ends on (tapuntil/waituntil against scripts/mister/gbc/Command Master.refs), because two real-time runs of the same fixed taps drift several boxes apart. Saved with the game's MAIN MENU > セーブ after the tutorial, then the OSD opened. The 1024-byte file is the 256-byte EEPROM four times over, in mGBA's byte order.
